entries.en: to inquire into; to find out, to sound out
to examine by looking; to observe (someone's movements and situation)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑:省/看]，且“也動静”与音写对应不稳，释义据“省…动静”文义。

entries.en: to examine by searching; to search and verify

entries.zh: 考核经书（经义）；考察境内（存疑）
entries.en: to examine the classics; (per the Spanish) to survey the realm — sense uncertain
entries.notes: H“考經”与 L“examinar el reyno（考察王国）”字面不合，疑为“考经界”（丈量疆界）之省，未敢定。

entries.zh: 考校能否胜任；试探做得到做不到
entries.en: to examine whether one is fit for it or not; to test whether it can be done
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑]，末二字“會袂”为能与不能之对，释义据文义推。

entries.en: to examine whether there is injury or decay (damage)
to inspect a corpse (examine the wounds of the dead)

entries.zh: 验尸；验看尸体以定死因
entries.en: to perform a coroner's examination of a corpse; autopsy
coroner; the yamen officer who examines corpses
entries.notes: 音写栏混入西语词（mira、asi 等）不可据，唯 H“仵作”与 L“examinar las heridas del muerto”相合，首字标[疑]。

entries.zh: 呼音；出声试读、考校读音
entries.en: to test by calling out the sound; to examine pronunciation
entries.notes: L 栏“examinar la q nada”文义不明（疑有脱字），仅 H/M 可读，释义存疑。

entries.en: to question closely; to inquire into
entries.notes: L 栏“si mirandola justa”文句讹误，释义据 H“省問”（察问）定。

entries.zh: 设考；为授学位、升等而设考试
entries.en: to set an examination (for the taking of degrees)

entries.zh: 查后手；核对后补的账目（余数）
entries.en: to check afterwards; to verify the later (remaining) entries
entries.notes: L 栏“los llenos en lama”疑为“los libros en la mano”（查核手头账簿）之讹，“后手”指后续经手或余数，义未尽合。

entries.zh: 殿试；科举最高一级的殿廷考试
entries.en: palace examination, the highest stage of the imperial examinations
the imperial civil service examinations; to sit for the examinations
entries.notes: L 栏“engenar”讹误（当作 graduarse 一类），释义据 H“科舉”及音写定。

entries.en: it has been examined and found; ascertained

entries.zh: 不足算；因低劣不合格而不予计入
entries.en: excluded as bad; not worth reckoning (disqualified)
entries.notes: H 末字标[疑:算/筦]，音写栏并列两种读法，释义据“不足算”文义。

entries.zh: 印；盖印、印记〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: seal; to stamp (text damaged; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: H 栏标[残]，L“Exedel canso~”不可读，材料不足。
